pages.title: Feed and filament
pages.text: The Siemens Deposition Reactor turns purified trichlorosilane into high-purity polysilicon. The standard process also needs a quartz deposition filament, which is retained.$(br2)Supply power and magma heat to reach a target temperature of 1,000.

pages.title: Growth phases
pages.text: The batch passes through preheating, nucleation, rod growth, and controlled cooling. Inputs remain locked during the batch.$(br2)Maintain power and heat, then collect the polysilicon, silicon tetrachloride, and hydrogen. Send the chemical byproducts to the $(l:siliconic:chemical_recycler)recycler$(/l).

pages.title: Interrupted batches
pages.text: To stop an unfinished batch, clear output space and press "Abort and recover rod". The feed is consumed; the standard process retains its filament.$(br2)Process the resulting partial polysilicon rod with more purified trichlorosilane in the reactor's recovery recipe.
